name: @jeffreyjyz/opencode-context
description: Context-window breakdown for opencode: a /context dialog plus a context_breakdown tool showing where the window went (system prompt, tool definitions, thinking, tool I/O, messages), delta.app style.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @opencode/plugin && bun scripts/build-tui.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
